manifest.name: SceneShowcase
manifest.description: A tour of the desktop's 3D scene vocabulary in one stage window plus a little world presence: a material-preset gallery under a studio look, a neon arcade corner with bloom, additive lines and GPU particles, an extruded gold title under a sunset sky with an orbit camera, a draggable desktop companion with a label and a trail, and a guide panel window that rides a slowly turning world node. Uses only public messages and follows the active palette.

interface.name: SceneShowcase
interface.description: Opens the 3D showcase (stage window, guide panel, desktop companion) and switches its stations.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Opens the stage window and the guide panel (riding its world dock), adds the desktop companion, registers the showcaseEnamel material preset, and shows the saved station. Idempotent: raises the stage when already open.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Removes the companion and the dock from the desktop, closes both windows, and unregisters the showcaseEnamel preset. Station and companion position are kept in data.

methods.name: setStation
methods.description: Shows one station on the stage: materials (preset gallery, studio look), arcade (neon look, bloom, particles) or title (extruded text, sunset, orbit camera).

methods.name: summonCompanion
methods.description: Springs the desktop companion back to its home spot under the guide panel (a spring animate op on a world node).

methods.name: toggleRide
methods.description: Attaches the guide panel window to its turning world dock, or detaches it.

parameters.name: ride
parameters.description: true to ride, false to let go; omitted toggles

methods.name: sceneInfo
methods.description: Reads WidgetManager getSceneParams and shows the connected screen's GPU capabilities and running stats in the guide panel.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: The current station, companion position, ride state and window ids.

returns.reference: { station, ride, companion, windowId, hudId, enamelRegistered }

methods.name: changed
methods.description: Widget callback: clicks on the guide panel buttons.

methods.name: nodeInput
methods.description: Scene input: clicking a stage shape wobbles it; dragging the companion reports dragStart/dragEnd (its dropped position is saved); clicking it bursts sparks; cameraChange from the title station's orbit camera.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: mousedown | mouseup | dragStart | dragMove | dragEnd | cameraChange | ...

methods.name: windowCloseRequested
methods.description: Closing the guide panel closes just the panel; closing the stage closes the whole showcase.
